name: Smoked Salmon, Cream Cheese & Cucumber Roll-Ups with Side Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ lemons
3 English cucumbers
3 yellow bell peppers
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Cut cream cheese into small pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the cream cheese.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl. Use the back of a spoon to soften and combine the cream cheese mixture.
Juice lemons into the bowl. Add yogurt, salt, and pepper; stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into (thin) half-moons.
Lay tortillas on a flat surface. Using a spatula, spread cream cheese mixture evenly over each tortilla.
Top tortillas with half of the cucumbers (reserve remaining cucumbers for the salad) and the salmon; roll tightly to close and cut crosswise into pieces. Set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add reserved cucumbers to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and thinly slice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl, along with the pine nuts, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide roll-ups and salad between plates. Enjoy!
